properties.name: An analysis a consumer needs exists for them only when it is served, named and gated — a script in reflow2's own checkout is none of those
properties.statement:
A capability reflow2 claims to offer "on any project" is offered to a consumer only when all three consumer legs are present: it is SERVED (an MCP tool, so `find_tools` can return it and the loop can name it), NAMED (a skill says when to reach for it, in the user's words), and GATED (a check fails the build when a capability claiming reach beyond this repo is realized only by something a consumer never receives). Code generalised in this checkout and left as a script under tools/ satisfies none of them, and this checkout cannot feel that, because it has the script.

The instance: tools/wall_check.py, built 2026-08-20, generalised 2026-08-21, re-written by hand on a consumer project 2026-09-14 and filed as "unknown". The class: fact:the-commands-cover-nine-of-twenty-skills-and-the-checkout-cannot-feel-it, one month earlier, the same blind spot in the environment.

Anthony's word, 2026-09-14: "I'd like to fix this for all 4." The wall check is the first; the other three source-reading analyses follow under dec:reflow2-serves-source-reading-analyses-that-report-and-never-write once their questions are defined in the user's terms.
